tips.title: 💡 Tips
tips.tip1_content: Selecting a preset template quickly configures common tech stacks with all parameters automatically set, perfect for beginners.
tips.tip2_content: Prefer *-slim or *-alpine image versions, smaller size and higher security.
tips.tip3_content: Remember to download .dockerignore file to exclude unnecessary files (like node_modules), speeds up build.
tips.tip4_content: For complex projects, generate multi-stage Dockerfile, build first then run, reduces final image size.
